description: This file defines a template class 'JsonRpcInterface' for managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSockets. It includes methods for sending requests, handling responses and notifications, and managing asynchronous response promises. The class is designed to be inherited and used with a derived class that implements the 'send' method.

classes.name: JsonRpcInterface
classes.description: A template interface class facilitating JSON-RPC over WebSocket communication, supporting request-response handling, notifications, and asynchronous response management.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request and awaits the response asynchronously, returning true if successful.

methods.name: setNotificationHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler function to process incoming notifications.
